info.title: GymApp API
info.description: Errors always follow `{ statusCode, code, message, details? }`. Branch on `code`; `message` is localized via `Accept-Language` (es default, en).

doc.description:
The document. Always: `id` (UUID v4, client-generated) and `updatedAt` (ISO, client clock —
decides conflicts). Upsert: the full document (same fields as the REST create body).
Delete: `id`, `updatedAt` and optionally `deletedAt`.

changes.description: Applied in order. Each change succeeds or fails on its own.

id.description: Stored id; may differ from the sent one (user_exercise_prefs are keyed by exerciseId).

status.description:
`applied`: the server now holds this version (also for an exact replay — idempotent).
`ignored_older`: the server has a newer `updatedAt`; pull to get it.
`error`: rejected; see `error`.

changes.description: Per collection: documents changed since `since`, deleted ones included (`deletedAt` set).

code.description: Stable machine identifier, e.g. `premium`. Immutable after creation.

isDefault.description: Setting a plan as default un-sets the previous default.
Setting a plan as default un-sets the previous default.

restSoundId.description: Effective sound: null when none is chosen, it was deleted, or the plan no longer allows it.
Rest-alarm sound id; `null` goes back to the default sound.

trainingReminderSoundId.description: Training-reminder sound id; `null` goes back to the default sound.

weighInSoundId.description: Weigh-in-reminder sound id; `null` goes back to the default sound.

language.description: UI/email language. Defaults to the request's Accept-Language.

refreshToken.description: Opaque, single-use. Send it to /auth/refresh to get a new pair.

password.description: Only bounded, not policy-checked: old passwords may predate the current rules.
Re-authentication: a stolen access token alone can't delete the account.

personalTiers.description: The caller's own tier per goal; `null` = none (the global tier applies).

tiers.description: Columns in S → C order; within a column, sorted by localized name.

unranked.description: No tier for this goal (e.g. custom exercises).

imageUrl.description: Must be a Cloudinary URL obtained via POST /media/upload-signature. `null` removes it.

hypertrophy.description: Omit to leave unchanged; `null` to unrank.

notFound.description: Ids that don't exist, are deleted or aren't global.

transformation.description: Incoming transformation: caps dimensions before Cloudinary stores the image. Absent for sounds.

type.description: Only for progress photos: private delivery. Must be sent as-is (it is signed).

asset_folder.description: Media Library folder (dynamic folder mode). Same path as `public_id`, minus the id.

maxFileSizeBytes.description: Client-side check only; the hard cap lives in the Cloudinary upload preset/account.

expiresAt.description: Cloudinary rejects signatures older than 1 hour.

percent.description: % to remove from weight or from the number of working sets.

roundingKg.description: Plate rounding; defaults to 2.5 kg (compound) / 1 kg (isolation).

deload.description: Overrides the program's deload config for this exercise.

reps.description: Overrides the routine's reps (repsMin = repsMax) that week.

sets.description: Overrides the number of working sets that week.

weeks.description: One entry per week; cycled if the program is longer.
